subject: table: Add option `SkipWriteUntouchedIndices` for `Table.UpdateRecord` (#55192)
summary: Reviewed this commit vs its parent. Change is a refactor/feature-gate: adds `table.SkipWriteUntouchedIndices` UpdateRecord option and moves the existing autocommit-only skip decision from `TableCommon` into `executor.updateRecord` (enabled only when `!InTxn && !InHandleForeignKeyTrigger && !HasFKCascades`). `TableCommon.updateRecord` now rebuilds indices via `rebuildUpdateRecordIndices` and skips writing truly-untouched index KVs only when the option is set. No Blocker/High correctness, consistency, or FK/txn semantic issues found in the touched executor/table paths.
